verdict: Lead flow has stalled this week; nine overdue deliverables are the root cause.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 36 leads at a cost of $43.86 each, and the most recent week saw leads drop 41% while cost per lead spiked 44% — the last three days produced zero leads on meaningful daily spend. At the same time, your Google Business Profile activity fell 79% week-over-week and hit zero on the final two days of the period, meaning fewer people are finding you organically before paid ads even enter the picture. The structural ceiling here traces to nine planned deliverables — including heating campaigns, fall creative, and the LSA heating toggle — that are past due and not yet live heading into peak heating season. Those items are being prioritized for completion this week so paid and organic channels can work together. Once the heating campaigns and content are live, you should see top-of-funnel volume recover and cost per lead come back down.
